import argparse
import cv2
import os

from ppstructure import PPStructureV2Table
from ppstructure.utility import draw_structure_result
from ppstructure.table.table_process import TableStructurer

from paddlestructure.ocr import (
    PPStructureDetModel,
    PPStructureRecModel,
    PPStructureTableModel,
    PPStructureDetPreprocessor,
    PPStructureDetPostprocessor,
)
from fastdeploy import RuntimeOption, Backend, Device

def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="PPOCR Structure Table Inference")
    parser.add_argument('--det_model', type=str, required=True, help='Path to detection model directory')
    parser.add_argument('--rec_model', type=str, required=True, help='Path to recognition model directory')
    parser.add_argument('--table_model', type=str, required=True, help='Path to table recognition model directory')
    parser.add_argument('--rec_label_file', type=str, required=True, help='Path to recognition model label file')
    parser.add_argument('--table_char_dict_path', type=str, required=True, help='Path to table recognition dictionary')
    parser.add_argument('--rec_batch_num', type=int, default=6, help='Recognition model inference batch size')
    parser.add_argument('--image_path', type=str, required=True, help='Path to test image file')
    parser.add_argument('--device', type=str, default='cpu', choices=['cpu', 'gpu'], help='Inference device type')
    parser.add_argument('--device_id', type=int, default=0, help='Device ID')
    parser.add_argument('--backend', type=str, default='ort', choices=['ort', 'paddle', 'trt'], help='Inference backend type')
    return parser.parse_args()

def build_runtime_option(device, device_id, backend, model_name):
    option = RuntimeOption()
    if device == 'cpu':
        option.use_cpu()
        if backend == 'ort':
            option.use_ort_backend()
        elif backend == 'paddle':
            option.use_paddle_backend()
    elif device == 'gpu':
        option.use_gpu(device_id)
        if backend == 'ort':
            option.use_ort_backend()
        elif backend == 'paddle':
            option.use_paddle_backend()
        elif backend == 'trt':
            option.use_trt_backend()
            # Set dynamic shape for TensorRT
            if model_name == 'det':
                option.set_trt_input_shape("x", [1, 3, 640, 640], [1, 3, 1024, 1024], [1, 3, 1536, 1536])
                trt_cache = "det_model.trt"
            elif model_name == 'rec':
                option.set_trt_input_shape("x", [1, 3, 32, 10], [args.rec_batch_num, 3, 32, 320], [args.rec_batch_num, 3, 32, 2304])
                trt_cache = "rec_model.trt"
            elif model_name == 'table':
                option.set_trt_input_shape("x", [1, 3, 488, 488], [1, 3, 488, 488], [1, 3, 488, 488])
                trt_cache = "table_model.trt"
            else:
                trt_cache = "model.trt"
            option.set_trt_cache_file(trt_cache)
    return option

if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = parse_args()

    # Build runtime options
    det_option = build_runtime_option(args.device, args.device_id, args.backend, 'det')
    rec_option = build_runtime_option(args.device, args.device_id, args.backend, 'rec')
    table_option = build_runtime_option(args.device, args.device_id, args.backend, 'table')

    # Load models
    det_model = PPStructureDetModel(args.det_model, runtime_option=det_option)
    rec_model = PPStructureRecModel(args.rec_model, args.rec_label_file, runtime_option=rec_option)
    table_model = PPStructureTableModel(args.table_model, args.table_char_dict_path, runtime_option=table_option)

    # Set preprocessor and postprocessor for detection model
    det_model.preprocessor = PPStructureDetPreprocessor()
    det_model.postprocessor = PPStructureDetPostprocessor()

    # Create PPStructureV2Table instance
    structure = PPStructureV2Table(det_model=det_model, rec_model=rec_model, table_model=table_model)
    structure.rec_batch_num = args.rec_batch_num

    # Read input image
    img = cv2.imread(args.image_path)
    if img is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image not found: {args.image_path}")

    # Predict and print results
    results = structure(img)
    print(results)

    # Visualize and save results
    vis_img = draw_structure_result(img, results, font_path=args.rec_label_file)
    save_path = os.path.splitext(args.image_path)[0] + "_vis.jpg"
    cv2.imwrite(save_path, vis_img)
    print(f"Visualized result saved to {save_path}")
